final: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(ft.account_id) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts AS a JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c.town_city), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city), totals AS (SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city) AS town_transaction_count, AVG(transaction_count) OVER () AS average_transaction_count FROM account_counts) SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, 1.0 * transaction_count / NULLIF(town_transaction_count, 0) AS town_transaction_share, 1.0 * transaction_count / NULLIF(average_transaction_count, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM totals ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, account_id LIMIT 10
